def ascii_source_inverse(generated, proof):
    """Read both complete assembly products and invert the two exact op tails."""
    before,_=fixed(PLAN['fixed_controls']['R11-author:before/file_render_checker_word64_bytes.hepta'])
    def split(raw):
        pieces=raw.split(b'\nfn ')
        require(len(pieces)==108 and pieces[0]==b'hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 file_render_checker_v4',
            'R11 complete assembly module/functions differ')
        result={}
        for index,piece in enumerate(pieces[1:]):
            body=b'fn '+piece
            require(body.split(b'(',1)[0]==('fn f'+str(index)).encode(),'R11 complete function order differs')
            result[index]=body
        return result
    def operation_lines(operations):
        lines=[]
        for operation in operations:
            require(set(operation)=={'op','args','out','attrs'} and len(operation['out'])==1,
                'R11 exact scalar operation shape differs')
            output=operation['out'][0]
            require(set(output)=={'name','type'},'R11 exact scalar output differs')
            line='  '+output['name']+':'+output['type']+' = '+operation['op']+'('+','.join(operation['args'])+')'
            if operation['attrs']:
                line+=' '+json.dumps(operation['attrs'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
            lines.append((line+'\n').encode())
        return b''.join(lines)
    old,new=split(before),split(generated)
    edits=proof['edits'];require(len(edits)==2,'R11 exact two edits differ')
    altered={16,79}
    for index in range(107):
        require(old[index].split(b'\n',1)[0]==new[index].split(b'\n',1)[0],
            'R11 function ABI or effect header differs')
        if index not in altered:
            require(old[index]==new[index],'R11 unselected full function differs')
    restored=generated;rows=[]
    for edit,fi,bi in zip(edits,(16,79),(7,4),strict=True):
        require(edit['path']==['functions',fi,'blocks',bi,'ops'],'R11 exact operation path differs')
        old_lines=old[fi].splitlines(keepends=True);new_lines=new[fi].splitlines(keepends=True)
        old_block=[i for i,line in enumerate(old_lines) if line.startswith(b'block ')]
        new_block=[i for i,line in enumerate(new_lines) if line.startswith(b'block ')]
        require(len(old_block)==len(new_block) and old_lines[old_block[bi]]==new_lines[new_block[bi]],
            'R11 complete block count/selected parameter ABI differs')
        begin_old=old_block[bi];begin_new=new_block[bi]
        end_old=old_block[bi+1] if bi+1<len(old_block) else next(i for i in range(begin_old+1,len(old_lines)) if old_lines[i]==b'end\n')
        end_new=new_block[bi+1] if bi+1<len(new_block) else next(i for i in range(begin_new+1,len(new_lines)) if new_lines[i]==b'end\n')
        old_ops=operation_lines(edit['before']);new_ops=operation_lines(edit['after'])
        require(b''.join(old_lines[begin_old+1:end_old-1])==old_ops
            and b''.join(new_lines[begin_new+1:end_new-1])==new_ops
            and old_lines[end_old-1]==new_lines[end_new-1],
            'R11 actual complete operation list/terminator differs')
        old_segment=b''.join(old_lines[begin_old:end_old]);new_segment=b''.join(new_lines[begin_new:end_new])
        require(new[fi].count(new_segment)==1
            and new[fi].replace(new_segment,old_segment,1)==old[fi],
            'R11 whole selected function inverse differs')
        require(restored.count(new[fi])==1,'R11 whole-source function inverse is not unique')
        restored=restored.replace(new[fi],old[fi],1)
        rows.append({'function':fi,'block_index':bi,'before_operations':len(edit['before']),
                     'after_operations':len(edit['after']),'full_selected_function_inverse':True})
    require(restored==before,'R11 complete rendered source inverse differs')
    scalar_layer=source_function_inverse(before)
    return {'functions':107,'unchanged_complete_functions':105,'all_function_ABIs_equal':True,
        'all_block_ABIs_terminators_and_nonselected_operations_equal':True,
        'complete_rendered_source_inverse_equal':True,'exact_editpaths':2,
        'before':pin(before),'after':pin(generated),'changed_functions':sorted(altered),
        'selected_blocks':rows,'retained_R10_scalar_source_inverse':scalar_layer}
